caseName: Orleans Parish Board of Supervisors of Elections v. Dundee
caseNameFull: Orleans Parish Board of Supervisors of Elections v. Dundee

opinions.text:
Appeal from C. A. 5th Cir. Judgment vacated and case remanded for reconsideration in light of amendments to Sections 1909, 1931, and 1995 of Title 47 of Louisiana Revised Statutes of 1950, enacted by the Legislature of Louisiana by Act No. 232 on July 2, 1970.

Mr. Justice Douglas dissents from this action of the Court.
